ArtifactKind.description:
The kinds of Source Artifact the contract recognises.

Serialized in `snake_case`, matching the conceptual contract in MVP-SPEC §10.

oneOf.description: A diff hunk from the turn.
A summary of a tool call.

CaptureSource.description: Adapter and session coordinates of a capture.

adapter_version.description: Adapter version that produced the envelope.

message_id.description: Adapter message identifier within the session.

ProjectRef.description: Reference to the Project a capture belongs to.

canonical_path.description:
Canonicalized project path; never empty. Canonicalization and the
allow-list check are the ingest API's job (MVP-SPEC §7.3).

SourceArtifact.description: A single immutable artifact within a capture.

artifact_id.description: Stable identifier of this artifact (UUID v7).

content.description: Opaque content string; never empty. No size bound is imposed here.

fingerprint.description: Lowercase SHA-256 of the artifact content.

kind.description: What kind of content the artifact carries.

metadata.description: Open metadata object; extra keys are allowed inside it.

description:
A versioned package of Source Artifacts produced by one adapter.

Consumers written in Rust **must validate the value against the generated
JSON Schema before deserializing**. Typed deserialization alone does not
enforce the `const: 1` on `schema_version`, because the field is a plain
`u32`; version enforcement is the ingest API's responsibility (MVP-SPEC
§7.3) and lands with ticket 09.

artifacts.description: The captured artifacts, at least one per turn.

capture_id.description: Stable identifier of this capture (UUID v7).

observed_at.description: RFC 3339 timestamp of when the adapter observed the turn.

project.description: Which Project the capture belongs to.

schema_version.description:
Contract version; the schema pins this to
[`CAPTURE_ENVELOPE_SCHEMA_VERSION`].

Deserialization accepts any `u32`; only schema validation applies the
`const: 1`. Validate against the schema before trusting this value.
